title: Sunflower Kindergarten Snack Heist
macguffin: the precious box of choco-bee snacks
intro: Ten minutes before the end-of-week reward, the class's single, prized box of choco-bee snacks vanished from the teacher's desk drawer.
setting: Sunflower Kindergarten classroom during rainy nap time. The classroom door is locked from the outside, keeping everyone trapped until the snacks are returned.
timeline: The choco-bee snack box was placed safely in the teacher's desk drawer before nap time.
A soft squeak and rustling noise came from the front of the room while everyone pretended to sleep.
The desk drawer was left slightly ajar with a single wrapper left behind.
The empty snack box was discovered right as the nap-time bell rang.

evidence.name: Sticky smudge
evidence.detail: A smear of sweet chocolate syrup is smeared across the handle of the desk drawer.

evidence.name: Blanket trail
evidence.detail: A small blue nap-time blanket was dragged across the reading rug.

evidence.name: Open latch
evidence.detail: The class hamster cage was found unlatched during the incident.

evidence.name: Crayon mark
evidence.detail: A blue wax crayon mark was left pressing against the snack log sheet.

revelations: The theft required bypassing the squeaky floorboard right in front of the teacher's desk.
The classroom door was never opened during the entire nap-time window.
At least one alibi completely hides the fact that they were awake during nap time.

endings.culpritsCaught: The missing choco-bee snacks are recovered from a cubby, and the culprits are sentenced to the Thinking Corner.
endings.culpritsEscape: Nap time ends in total chaos, and the snacks vanish into tiny backpacks before anyone can prove a thing.

dialoguePrompts: Ask who was awake when the desk drawer squeaked.
Make the two best friends compare where they were during nap time.
Ask the teacher why the drawer was left unlocked.
Question the hamster's keeper about the open cage latch.

tasks.name: Follow the wrapper
tasks.detail: Match the wrapper smell and crumbs to the correct cubby.

tasks.name: Rebuild nap time
tasks.detail: Place the squeak, blanket trail, and bell in the correct order.

tasks.name: Guard the snack box
tasks.detail: Keep the recovered snacks safe while everyone argues about who took them.

tasks.name: Inspect the cage
tasks.detail: Decide whether the hamster escaped by accident or was used as a distraction.

conflicts: One child says nobody was awake, but their drawing has a fresh chocolate mark.
The teacher's alibi leaves exactly two minutes unaccounted for.
The blue blanket belongs to one child but was found near another child's cubby.
The hamster may have moved the wrapper, making one clue unreliable.
secretObjectives: Protect your best friend even if the story becomes confusing.
Get the snacks back without admitting you were awake.
Convince everyone the hamster caused the mess.
Trade one clue for an extra snack before the final bell.
twists: The snack box was hidden before nap time as part of a secret sharing plan.
The wrapper belongs to yesterday's snack, not today's box.
The teacher moved the box earlier and forgot where it was placed.

cast.name: Bo
cast.personality: a class troublemaker who is always hungry
cast.alibi: Was in the sandbox the whole time, ask anyone!
cast.fact: Nana was seen near the teacher's desk during nap time.

cast.name: Nana
cast.personality: Bo's best friend and a terrible liar
cast.alibi: Went to get a nap-time blanket from the desk area, nothing else!
cast.fact: Mimi has chocolate on her sleeve.

cast.name: Mimi
cast.personality: a class president very serious about justice
cast.alibi: Was organizing the crayon box like every day at that time.
cast.fact: Bo asked to borrow snack money yesterday.

cast.name: Teo
cast.personality: a new kid still learning everyone's names
cast.alibi: Does not really know where they were, getting lost easily here.
cast.fact: The teacher left the drawer unlocked by accident.

cast.name: Miss Hana
cast.alibi: Stepped out to answer the office phone for two minutes.
cast.fact: Nana never even likes choco-bee snacks.

cast.name: Pip
cast.fact: Pip's cage was mysteriously open that day.
